visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a metallic spoon spreading a bright, viscous orange egg yolk mixture onto a rustic slice of toasted nut bread. Large, playful orange and white text overlays the top. (2) The perspective shifts to a pair of hands demonstrating the preparation; a raw egg yolk is held in a palm and then placed into a white ceramic ramekin. Green-tinted olive oil is poured from a glass bottle to submerge the yolk. (3) Slices of garlic, dried herbs, and ground black pepper are layered into the ramekin over the yolk. (4) A male creator with long, dark curly hair and a black t-shirt appears against a clean studio background, gesturing and explaining. The shot alternates between his instructional face-on view and close-ups of the cooked spread being smeared smoothly onto bread and sprinkled with cheese powder. (5) The creator bites into the toast with a satisfied expression. Slow-motion shots emphasize the creamy, jam-like texture of the egg yolk. (6) A variation is shown using dark sesame oil and ginger slices, which is then spread onto a piece of steamed white bun. The creator compares the two versions, holding both pieces of bread/bun toward the camera with a thumbs-up and energetic gestures in a bright kitchen setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A vibrant male voice introduces the 'God-level spread' with high arousal and fast speech rate. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop music with a steady drum beat begins immediately. (2) As the yolk is handled, there is a subtle thud of a ramekin on wood, followed by the distinct sound of oil pouring with a light splashing texture. (3) A metallic clicking and grinding sound accompanies the black pepper being ground. The vocal remains instructional and friendly. (4) The music continues as the speaker explains temperatures; the metallic scraping sound of a spoon spreading the mixture over toast is prominent. (5) A crunching sound is heard as the creator bites the toast. His voice becomes more expressive with 'Mmm' sounds. (6) A shift occurs as the speaker introduces the black sesame oil variation; the music remains consistent, concluding with a light laughter sound effect at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Demonstration -> Results -> Variation -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers an extremely simple but high-impact recipe for an oil-confit egg yolk spread. It uses a high-energy tutorial format to demonstrate both Western and Taiwanese flavor profiles to maximize audience appeal and encourage home cooking.
